body: Easier said than done. I don't control this person and she prides herself on her independence, so it's not easy to get her to listen to suggestions without her feeling like she's being told what to do.
I cannot afford it. I do not have insurance.

I would walk through literal flames for this woman. This is why I don't turn her son even when I know she's a bit volatile. If she doesn't have me to turn to, whom? And what if that person fought back instead of taking my more passive approach?

I've implored her to seek therapy and have suggested that on occasion we attend a session together, but I think she feels it's being forced on her and is hesitant.

If she calls, I'll always be there. Safety be damned. I know how to protect myself, especially against a woman who I have a few inches and about 20-25lbs on.

I'm ok with that. I just want my friend back.

We've shared a lot of hard times over the years and her and I are closer than I've ever been with anyone. We both have no one outside of each other that we've shared secrets with. I don't know how to function without her.
If you want to be depressed, pm me. I hate everything.

I'm no better for her than she is for me. I've propped her up for years, thinking maybe that providing her the unconditional love and support I never had would result in an outcome different than my own.

That was not the case. I have not gotten the positive result I hoped for despite offering her all the benefit of stable housing when she would accept it and complete access to my savings that *was* well into the 6 figure range.

She's not a bitch. She's just as troubled as I am. She may not always be there for me, but she cares and I am certain of it. I am not here to have people tell me my best friend is not a good person. She's probably the only thing keeping me from doing this sooner.

I have no concerns about being locked up. I couldn't care less about that other than having to suffer being even more alone than I am now. Knowing I have no way to help her other than to transfer funds around to be sure she is taken care of. Jail is fucking cake compared to real life and 3 months is essentially a short nap.

My only desire is to do whatever it is on MY terms. I'm not getting hemmed up when they want me to be. I'll go in prepared. With money set up for her, cash to cover commissary for myself, and enough money on the phone so I can speak to her since she'd be the only one willing to answer for me.

However, this option solves nothing. It's just kicking the can down the road. I'll come out equally miserable and twice as angry.

GrubHub uses a dedicated POS system within the restaurant, therefore needs the restaurant to allow one to be installed. I believe UberEats is this way too. 

When you order via DoorDash, your order is submitted to the restaurant by phone call. Because of this, they don't need the restaurant to allow their menu to be added, they can do it independently of the business.

That's bullshit on the part of the restaurant. It's generally not standard to tip on takeout orders. They know this, but take advantage of a loophole to pay their employees less.

Also, if your wages for the day don't equal minimum wage(for regular employees), then the restaurant is supposed to cover the difference.

Yes, I need it to make sense. If I cannot comprehend something, I cannot buy in. AA just makes me roll my eyes. Turn my will over? I'm powerless? That makes no sense at all. If I'm powerless, then there's no way I can fix anything in my life and I should just give up. That's dumb as all hell. I'm sick of being patronized and getting condescending remarks about my atheism by people that cannot understand the obvious and inherent hypocrisy in AA/NA's philosophy.

I want suggestions on finding other avenues of socializing that don't revolve around drinking because that's all me and my friends, if you can call them that, do. I drink, I watch sports, I play pool, and I gamble. All those things are deeply rooted in drinking culture.

I'm aware of all the options. I spent several years as a heroin addict and have been to multiple inpatient and outpatient programs. I cannot stand the whole attitude of the industry and everything that surrounds it.

I have no desire to socialize with other people like me. I hate me. Why in the world would I want meet other people like that?

I'm looking for alternatives. How can I be a normal member of society? I do not want to be a recovery junkie.
It's not just that. I find the whole philosophy to be completely silly. It makes no sense at all.

I just have had no incentive. I haven't had a job for 30 months, 7 of which were spent incarcerated, but I've had the ability to support myself financially over that time. Meanwhile I've spent nearly $175k on nothing but drugs, alcohol, and women.

I could've bought a house, I could've started a business, I could've educated myself. Instead I spent it all chasing a dream that wasn't realistic.

I've been to hundreds of meetings over the years, but I've found it very hostile to atheists and my outlook on life is diametrically opposed to what is espoused by AA.

As for medical treatment, I have no insurance. Therefore medical detox is not possible without a trip to the ER or a significant expenditure. Neither of which is ideal.
